title: hebe lycopodioides
intro: Hebe lycopodioides, commonly known as New Zealand oropendika, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It has been traditionally used in New Zealand for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are beneficial for wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Hebe lycopodioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
